title: moquiniastrum mollissimum
intro: Moquiniastrum mollissimum, commonly known as Velvet Tree or Velvet Leaf, is a plant species native to the Americas. It is a medicinal plant used in traditional medicine, particularly in Mexico and Central America, for its various health benefits. The plant is valued for its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help in reducing pain, fever, and infections. The bioactive constituents of Moquiniastrum mollissimum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
